description_en: Queries the details of an approval instance under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下审批实例详情
name: GetApproval

parameters.help_en:
The approval instance ID. You can obtain the value from the following operations:
[ListApprovals](~~ListApprovals~~): Lists approval instances.
[GetApproval](~~GetApproval~~): Queries the details of an approval instance
parameters.help_zh:
审批实例ID。取值来源：
[ListApprovals](~~ListApprovals~~)：批量查询审批实例列表。
[GetApproval](~~GetApproval~~)：查询审批实例详情
parameters.name: approval_id

Approval.description_en: The approval details list, which typically contains one record
Approval.description_zh: 审批详情列表，通常包含一条记录

ApprovalDetail.description_en: The details of the approval instance

ApprovalProgresses.description_en: The approval progress list. For backend reports without approval nodes, an empty array is returned
ApprovalProgresses.description_zh: 审批进度列表。后台报备无审批节点，返回空数组

Action.description_en:
The action performed on the approval progress node. Valid values:
Approve: Approved.
Reject: Rejected.
Revoke: Revoked.
Comment: Commented
Action.description_zh:
审批进展节点执行操作。取值：
Approve：通过。
Reject：拒绝。
Revoke：撤回。
Comment：评论

Comment.description_en: The comment on the approval progress node
Comment.description_zh: 审批进展节点执行评论

Executor.description_en: The executor ID of the approval progress node

Operators.description_en: The list of operators for the approval progress node
Operators.description_zh: 审批进展节点操作人列表

items.description_en: The operator of the approval progress node

SaseUserId.description_en: The ID of the operator for the approval progress node

Username.description_en: The username of the operator for the approval progress node
Username.description_zh: 审批进展节点操作人用户名

Status.description_en:
The status of the approval progress node. Valid values:
Pending: Pending approval.
Approved: Approved.
Rejected: Rejected.
Revoked: Revoked
Status.description_zh:
审批进展节点状态。取值：
Pending：待审批。
Approved：已通过。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Revoked：已撤回

Timestamp.description_en: The execution time of the approval progress node. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
Timestamp.description_zh: 审批进展节点执行时刻，秒级时间戳

ApprovalType.description_en:
The approval type. Valid values:
0: built-in approval.
1: DingTalk approval.
2: WeCom approval.
3: Lark approval
ApprovalType.description_zh:
审批类型。取值：
0：内置审批。
1：钉钉审批。
2：企业微信审批。
3：飞书审批

BackendReportDetail.description_en: The backend report details. This value is returned only when ReportType is set to BackendReport
BackendReportDetail.description_zh: 后台报备详情，仅 ReportType=BackendReport 时返回

AssociatedPolicyType.description_en: The associated policy type, which is the same as PolicyType
AssociatedPolicyType.description_zh: 关联策略类型，与 PolicyType 一致

Remark.description_en: The remark for the backend report, which is the same as the report reason
Remark.description_zh: 后台报备备注，与报备原因一致

ReportObject.description_en: The report object. The fields vary based on PolicyType. Fields within the object use camelCase naming
ReportObject.description_zh: 报备对象，字段随 PolicyType 变化。对象内字段使用小驼峰命名

TargetUser.description_en: The actual effective user of the backend report
TargetUser.description_zh: 后台报备的实际生效用户

UserId.description_en: The SASE user ID of the actual effective user
UserId.description_zh: 实际生效用户的 SASE 用户 ID

Username.description_en: The username of the actual effective user
Username.description_zh: 实际生效用户的用户名

BackendReportDetail.title_zh: 后台报备详情，仅 ReportType=BackendReport 时返回

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss

CreateTimeUnix.description_en: The creation time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds
CreateTimeUnix.description_zh: 创建时间，Unix 时间戳，单位为秒

CreatorDepartment.description_en: The department path of the report initiator
CreatorDepartment.description_zh: 报备发起人的部门路径

CreatorDevTag.description_en: The device ID of the terminal that created the approval instance
CreatorDevTag.description_zh: 审批实例创建终端设备ID

CreatorUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the approval instance. For backend reports, this is the actual effective user, not the administrator
CreatorUserId.description_zh: 审批实例创建人ID。后台报备中为实际生效用户，而非管理员

CreatorUsername.description_en: The username of the user who created the approval instance
CreatorUsername.description_zh: 审批实例创建人用户名

EffectStatus.description_en:
The effective status of the report. This value is an empty string when the approval status is not Approved. Valid values:
Enabled: valid.
Expired: expired
EffectStatus.description_zh:
报备生效状态。审批状态不是 Approved 时为空字符串。取值：
Enabled：有效。
Expired：已失效或已到期
EffectStatus.title_zh: 报备生效状态。Enabled 表示有效，Expired 表示已失效

EndTimestamp.description_en: The expiration time of the approval instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
EndTimestamp.description_zh: 审批实例有效截止时刻，秒级时间戳

PolicyType.description_en:
The policy type associated with the approval instance. Valid values:
DomainBlacklist: Domain name blacklist.
DomainWhitelist: Domain name whitelist.
SoftwareBlock: Software blocking.
DeviceRegistration: Excess registration.
AppUninstall: Client uninstallation.
DlpSend: File outbound transfer.
PeripheralBlock: Peripheral control.
EndpointHardening: Endpoint hardening.
oftwareHardening: Software hardening.
AiAgentBlock: AI Agent control.
PrivateAccessBlock: Private access
PolicyType.description_zh:
审批实例关联策略类型。取值：
DomainBlacklist：域名黑名单。
DomainWhitelist：域名白名单。
SoftwareBlock：软件禁用。
DeviceRegistration：超额注册。
AppUninstall：终端卸载。
DlpSend：文件外发。
PeripheralBlock：外设管控。
EndpointHardening：终端加固。
oftwareHardening：软件加固。
AiAgentBlock：AI Agent 管控。
PrivateAccessBlock：内网访问

ProcessId.description_en: The ID of the process associated with the approval instance

ProcessName.description_en: The name of the process associated with the approval instance
ProcessName.description_zh: 审批实例关联流程名称

Reason.description_en: The reason for creating the approval instance

ReportType.description_en:
The report type. Valid values:
ApprovalReport: approval report.
BackendReport: backend report
ReportType.description_zh:
报备类型。取值：
ApprovalReport：审批报备。
BackendReport：后台报备
ReportType.title_zh: 报备类型。ApprovalReport 表示审批报备，BackendReport 表示后台报备

SchemaContent.description_en: The content of the template associated with the approval instance
SchemaContent.description_zh: 审批实例关联模板内容

SchemaId.description_en: The ID of the template associated with the approval instance

SchemaName.description_en: The name of the template associated with the approval instance
SchemaName.description_zh: 审批实例关联模板名称

Status.description_en:
The instance status. Valid values:
Pending: Pending approval.
Approved: Approved.
Rejected: Denied.
Revoked: Revoked.
Expired: Expired.
Deleted: Deleted
Status.description_zh:
审批实例状态。取值：
Pending：待审批。
Approved：已通过。
Rejected：已拒绝。
Revoked：已撤回。
Expired：已过期。
Deleted：审批已删除

ValidityType.description_en:
The validity duration type. Valid values:
FixedTime: Expires at a specified time.
Permanent: Permanently valid
ValidityType.description_zh:
生效时长类型。取值：
FixedTime：在指定时间失效。
Permanent：永久有效
ValidityType.title_zh: 生效时长类型；Permanent 时 EndTimestamp 返回 0
